subject: POC cost, token volumes & credit confirmation
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference>
To: Sara Burns <sara.burns@olivetech.ai>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.inference
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC recap + cost qualification questions

Hi Sara — great conversation this morning, thanks for the time. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can size a POC and confirm credits: 

Key takeaways (from call):
- Goal: Surface semantic search + summarization in support center (50k monthly end-user searches initially)
- Latency SLO: 300–500ms p95 on short prompts, occasional long-form summarization allowed at higher latency
- Privacy: data stays in their VPC (Private deployment discussed)

Quick asks to size economics:
1) Estimated token volume (in + out) per month for the POC window — ballpark ranges are fine (e.g., 5M, 20M, 100M).
2) Budget range for infrastructure + service for the POC (monthly).
3) Desired target unit cost range (e.g., $ / 1M tokens) you’re aiming for so we can model quantization / instance tradeoffs.

We can offer initial credits for a 30-day POC; before I send a formal credit proposal I want the numbers above so I don’t under/over provision. Attached is a one-page mutual action plan we can iterate on.

Next steps I propose:
- You share rough token volumes + procurement contact (if different from procurement@olivetech.ai) — by EOD Thu
- I’ll sketch a cost model (unit economics and recommended config) and proposed credit amount — within 24 business hours after I have volumes
- If procurement wants an MSA/PO, I’ll loop in Legal and our procurement specialist (cc’d Monica)

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (xlsx, 1 page)

Thanks — happy to hop on a follow-up if that’s faster.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0182
diego.fernandez@redwood.inference
From: Sara Burns <sara.burns@olivetech.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@olivetech.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC recap + cost qualification questions

Hi Diego — thanks for the recap. Answering your asks below: 

1) Token estimate for a 30-day POC (approx):
- Avg prompt length: ~120 tokens in, ~180 tokens out (search + short answer)
- Estimated monthly tokens (in+out): 18M–30M
- Peak concurrency expected during business hours; average QPS ~ 1.5–2.0

2) Budget range for POC: $6k - $15k for a 30 day window (this is what the product and infra team can allocate without exec signoff).

3) Unit cost target: Ideally $50–$75 per 1M tokens; if we can see a path to <$60 that's very attractive.

Procurement: procurement@olivetech.ai (cc’d) — they will need a short SOW and a credit/consumption invoice for internal tracking.

I attached a quick usage projection (CSV) showing month-by-month ramp for the pilot and our internal justification doc. If we can get an initial credit allocation to cover the high end of the POC burn (30M tokens) that would remove approvals friction.

Attachments: usage_projection_q1.csv

Thanks,
Sara Burns
Head of Product — Search & AI
OliveTech
sara.burns@olivetech.ai
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference>
To: Sara Burns <sara.burns@olivetech.ai>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.inference, rachel_kim@redwood.inference
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC recap + cost qualification questions

Thanks Sara — this is exactly what I needed, very helpful. Based on the numbers you shared (up to 30M tokens, budget up to $15k, target $50–$75 / 1M):

Preliminary cost posture we can offer for the 30-day POC:
- Initial free credits: 50,000 consumption units (equivalent to ~30M tokens on our standard compact model profile) — this covers the high-end burn you provided.
- Trial extension: 14 extra days beyond the standard 30 to give you time for integration and evals.
- Unit economics guidance: expected operational unit price range $55–$85 / 1M tokens depending on model variant and quantization (we recommend starting with a 7B quantized variant to hit low-$60s).

I’ve attached a short credit agreement draft for your procurement team to review (non-executory; just outlines credit amount, retention window, and simple SOW bullets). If procurement is happy with the SOW, we can issue credits immediately and open a consumption invoice for tracking.

Next steps:
1) Sara/procurement to confirm acceptance of the credit draft or request edits — procurement@olivetech.ai
2) If accepted, we’ll issue credits and set up a dashboard that shows token burn in near real time.
3) Monica (cc) will handle onboarding + technical onboarding call scheduling.

Attachments: credit_agreement_draft.pdf (pdf)

If you’d like a short call to confirm the model choice and expected latency tradeoffs, I can schedule 30 minutes tomorrow.

Best,
Diego
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.inference, monica_patel@redwood.inference
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: POC recap + cost qualification questions — credit allocation (internal)

Rachel / Monica — forwarding the thread below. I approved an initial allocation of 50k consumption credits + a 14-day extension for OliveTech to cover up to ~30M tokens for the POC. Monica will own onboarding and will confirm when credits are issued.

Two risk items to keep an eye on:
- Burn rate: if they exceed ~5M tokens per week in the first two weeks we should consider a fast follow to pause or throttle and ask procurement for PO.
- Unit price target: they’re looking for sub-$60 / 1M in the long term — if they push for that we may need to propose a dedicated capacity commit.

If you’re comfortable, Rachel, please flag if you want additional approval thresholds (e.g., auto-grant another 50k if they prove integration).
